newsitem.title: UK: UniChem renews Lloyds Chemists bid.
newsitem.headline: UniChem renews Lloyds Chemists bid.

text.p: UK pharmeceutical chain UniChem said it renewed its bid for Lloyds Chemists, valuing the company at 657.6 million. The UniChem group already owns 9.9 percent of LLoyds.
For every 10 Lloyds Chemists shares, UniChem is offering 16 new UniChem shares and 926p in cash, valuing each Lloyds Chemists share at 505.4p.
UniChem identified cost savings and revenue beneifts "conservatively" to total more than 15 million stg in the 12 months after the acquisition and in excess of 20 million annually thereafter.
